name: reports-sync-prerequisite
goal: A fresh checkout runs the desktop and hub entry points without a manual reports sync: each syncs packages/reports before vite reads its sources.

steps.title: Identify the failing behavior, expected behavior, and reproduction.
steps.evidence: Fresh export: desktop build, build:mobile, test:unit and remote fixture fail on unsynced reports; hub build on desktop and reports, hub test:unit on desktop. Typecheck, lint, discovery pass.

steps.title: Write and run a failing regression test; record the defect assertion and command.
steps.evidence: Guard test/shared-sync.test.ts: 3 failed on unwired scripts. Export logs /tmp/harness-fresh-red-*.log: each entry point exit 1 with the tsconfig extends error.

steps.title: Implement the smallest repair without weakening the regression test.
steps.evidence: Entry points that start vite sync the packages they read first. One sync:shared script per package before five desktop and three hub scripts. Measured cost 0.7 s and 1.1 s.

steps.title: Repeat repair and the same unchanged regression test until it passes; record passing proof.
steps.evidence: Unchanged guard: 3 passed. Clean export, final files: build:mobile, root build:desktop, desktop unit 7, hub build, hub unit 336, fixture load all exit 0. /tmp/harness-fresh-final-*.log

steps.title: Run relevant project checks and affected UI browser flows with fresh inspected screenshots; keep pending until proof passes.
Apply the review: the proof is the fresh-export runs, not a test of script text.
steps.evidence: Mirror-only guard test removed. Clean export, final scripts: /tmp/harness-fresh-red-*.log exit 1, /tmp/harness-fresh-final-*.log exit 0. ios:acceptance wired after its imports failed fresh too.
